entities._comment: detect_magic is the requires_skill GATE and the arm banks ward_scrap_read ONLY -- it must never bank detected_wardwork. The Act V door deliberately withholds a fifth producer of that counter because it would cheapen the >=3 threshold its payoff variant reads (qa/fixtures/seal_reward_start.json pins the value at 3). Reading this scrap teaches the same literacy without spending that budget.
entities._light_comment: v0.17 R2 night-readability light. VISUAL-LOG named `hut_hearth_ash`; NOT used -- that prop's own toast says its ash is cold. Ward-green, low, steady, no flicker.
entities.skill_hint_toast: The scrap hums under the dust, and not the way dust hums.
entities.locked_toast: A palm-sized shard of grey stone on the shelf, cut along one edge with marks you cannot read.

on_skill_use.toast: [Detect Magic] — What is left here is one link of a boundary that once closed around the whole thicket. Its pull still faces inward, along the exact line the deer refuse to cross. It was drawn to keep something in; it stopped doing that a very long time ago.

entities.observe: A palm of grey stone lying flat on the shelf, one edge set square to the front. The rest of the shelf runs crooked.
The top shelf holds a row of stoppered jars with nothing left readable on the labels.
entities.toast: Every stopper is waxed and every jar is still full. The wax was pressed flat by a thumb and never broken since.

entities.observe: A rack of bundled stems, dried long past any use.
entities.toast: Yarrow, mostly, and a great deal of it. The bundles turn on their strings when the door moves.

entities.observe: Cold ash banked neatly against the back of the hearth.
entities.toast: The ash is banked the way you bank a fire you mean to wake in the morning. It has been cold for years.

entities.observe: One shutter, latched, with daylight coming through the slats in bars.
entities.toast: The latch is on the inside of the shutter, and the hut was shut when you came to it. Dust lies along the sill, unbroken.
